# mtncloud_load_balancer (Resource)

A load balancer on an MTN Network: a virtual IP address (VIP) that shares traffic across servers. Its listeners, pools, members and health monitors are their own resources. Creating one takes about 2 minutes. The name, description, tags and `enabled` change in place; the network, VIP subnet and VIP address replace it, with everything on it.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "mtncloud_load_balancer" "web" {
  network_id = mtncloud_network.app.id
  name       = "web"

  # Optional: the VIP address on the network's subnet. Left out, the cloud picks one.
  vip_address = "10.0.0.20"
  tags        = ["team-web"]
}

output "vip" {
  value = mtncloud_load_balancer.web.vip_address
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) The load balancer's name.
- `network_id` (Number) ID of the MTN Network the load balancer is on, for example `mtncloud_network.app.id`. Your tenant must own it: a network shared with you is read-only. Changing it replaces the resource.

### Optional

- `description` (String) A description.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the load balancer passes traffic. Defaults to `true`. **`false` takes the whole load balancer out of service**: every listener stops passing traffic until it is set back to `true`.
- `tags` (Set of String) Tags on the load balancer, at most 50.
- `timeouts` (Block, Optional) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--timeouts))
- `vip_address` (String) The VIP's address on the subnet. Left unset, the cloud picks a free one. Changing it replaces the load balancer.
- `vip_subnet_id` (String) The cloud ID of the subnet the VIP is on. Defaults to the network's subnet. Changing it replaces the load balancer.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The load balancer's ID.
- `operating_status` (String) `ONLINE` when its members answer their health checks; `OFFLINE` with no members.
- `provisioning_status` (String) `ACTIVE` once it is ready; `ERROR` if the cloud failed it.

- `delete` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours). Setting a timeout for a Delete operation is only applicable if changes are saved into state before the destroy operation occurs.
- `update` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours).

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import mtncloud_load_balancer.web <network_id>/<load_balancer_id>
```
